headline: The Zoning Board approved conditions for a 32-unit housing project, while officials advanced school facility plans and addressed landfill testing.
synopsis: The Zoning Board of Appeals unanimously approved comprehensive permit conditions for a 32-unit Chapter 40B rental townhouse project at 250 Turnpike Road. Ahead of the annual town election, the School Committee approved an informational letter detailing debt-exclusion ballot questions for roof projects at Neary and Trottier schools, while the Select Board contracted Tappe Architects for the Neary feasibility study. The Select Board also supported a reserve fund transfer to cover state-mandated environmental testing of private drinking wells near the municipal landfill. Additionally, officials evaluated parking constraints for proposed improvements at Fayville Memorial Park and discussed jurisdiction over neighbor complaints regarding a regional asphalt plant.

highlights.title: Zoning Board approves 32-unit 40B permit conditions
highlights.why: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted unanimously to approve comprehensive permit conditions for a 32-unit rental townhouse development at 250 Turnpike Road, which includes eight affordable units.

highlights.title: Architect selected for Neary School feasibility study
highlights.why: The Select Board awarded the designer services contract to Tappe Architects upon recommendation from the Elementary School Building Committee.

highlights.title: Reserve funds sought for landfill private well testing
highlights.why: The Select Board backed a $24,900 Reserve Fund transfer to fund state-mandated risk assessments and private drinking well testing near the landfill.

highlights.title: Parking layout evaluated for Fayville Memorial Park
highlights.why: The Recreation Commission reviewed community survey responses and parking constraints along Central Street for proposed park additions, including a splash pad and dog park.

highlights.title: Board discusses Brox asphalt plant complaints
highlights.why: The Board of Health reviewed odor and noise complaints, noting the plant is across the Marlborough line and under state MassDEP jurisdiction.

looking_ahead.what: Southborough Annual Town Election featuring school roof debt-exclusion ballot questions
Public design presentation for the Fayville Memorial Park project
Continued hearings on 22 Newton Street variance and 34 Turnpike Road special permit
